focus: User-facing decompilation options surface, variable recovery integration with the knowledge base (KB), type inference via Typehoon, and feedback loops triggered by KB mutations (user renames/retypes)

pipeline.name: Option Parsing & Preset Selection
pipeline.description: Decompiler.__init__ parses DecompilationOption list and maps them to class-specific handlers (clinic, codegen, region_simplifier, recursive_structurer, region_identifier, decompiler). Options are grouped by category and cached if clears_cache=False. Presets in presets/ (basic.py, fast.py, full.py, malware.py) select optimization pass chains per architecture/platform.
pipeline.inputs: options (list of DecompilationOption tuples), preset (str or DecompilationPreset object), optimization_passes override
pipeline.outputs: options_by_class dict (category -> param name), _optimization_passes list, _cache_parameters dict for cache key

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage Pipeline Execution
pipeline.description: ClinicStage enum (0-15) defines ordered transformation stages. Clinic._analyze() dispatches through stage-specific handlers (_stage_*) stored in stage_to_method dict. Each stage transforms the AIL graph and tracks state. RECOVER_VARIABLES (stage 13) runs VariableRecoveryFast. SEMANTIC_VARIABLE_NAMING (stage 14) applies usage-based naming.
pipeline.inputs: AIL graph, function info, cfg, variable_kb (optional KB with pre-existing variables), reset_variable_names flag
pipeline.outputs: variable_kb (populated VariableManagerInternal with recovered variables and types), arg_vvars dict, type_constraints for Typehoon

pipeline.name: Variable Recovery (VariableRecoveryFast)
pipeline.description: clinic._recover_and_link_variables() invokes VariableRecoveryFast analysis on AIL graph. Identifies stack, register, memory, and constant variables via SimEngineVRAIL. Generates type constraints (Subtype, Equivalence, DerivedTypeVariable) for each variable-location pair. Tracks vvar_id (VirtualVariable ID) to SimVariable mapping. Returns var_to_typevars mapping.
pipeline.inputs: ail_graph, arg_list, arg_vvars dict, vvar_to_vvar remap dict, type_hints list, func_args
pipeline.outputs: VariableRecoveryFastState with _variables region, type_constraints dict[TypeVariable -> set[TypeConstraint]], var_to_typevars dict[SimVariable -> set[TypeVariable]], stack_offset_typevars

pipeline.name: Ground-Truth Type Seeding
pipeline.description: Before Typehoon solver runs, clinic._recover_and_link_variables seeds ground_truth dict from: (1) kb.variables[func_addr].variables_with_manual_types (user-set types), (2) function.prototype.args (if not guessed). Ground truth overrides solver output for those TypeVariables. Stack variable max_sizes also constrain the solver.
pipeline.outputs: groundtruth dict[TypeVariable -> SimType], must_struct set[TypeVariable], tv_max_sizes dict[TypeVariable -> int]

pipeline.name: Type Inference (Typehoon Solver)
pipeline.description: Typehoon.analyze() runs SimpleSolver on type constraints. Constructs equivalence classes and subtype lattice over TypeVariables. Uses must_struct and ground_truth as fixed points. Generates simtypes_solution dict[TypeVariable -> SimType]. Then update_variable_types() writes inferred types back to var_manager.variable_to_types[SimVariable].
pipeline.inputs: type_constraints dict, func_var TypeVariable, ground_truth, must_struct, stackvar_max_sizes, constraint_set_degradation_threshold, tv_manager
pipeline.outputs: simtypes_solution, structs (inferred struct definitions), updated kb.variables[func_addr].variable_to_types

pipeline.name: Variable Unification & Naming
pipeline.description: clinic._recover_and_link_variables calls var_manager.unify_variables(interference) to merge SSA phi-related variables into canonical unified_variables. Then assign_unified_variable_names() applies heuristic naming (ip_r0, ip_s0, etc.) or preserves existing names if manually set. Semantic naming orchestrator runs multiple pattern classes in priority order (PointerNaming, ArrayIndexNaming, etc.), skipping already-renamed vars.
pipeline.inputs: variable_manager with all SSA variables, liveness.interference_graph(), kb.labels, function.prototype.arg_names, reset_variable_names flag
pipeline.outputs: _unified_variables set, _variables_to_unified_variables mapping, semantic_renamed variables, updated variable.name and variable.renamed flags

pipeline.name: Variable-to-AIL Linking
pipeline.description: clinic._link_variables_on_block() traverses every AIL block statement and expression, attaching resolved SimVariable refs to expressions via metadata. Enables code generation to later query which variable is used where. Uses find_variables_by_stmt(), find_variables_by_atom() from VariableManagerInternal.
pipeline.inputs: ail_graph blocks, variable_manager with variables, types, accesses
pipeline.outputs: AIL expressions tagged with variable references for code generation

pipeline.name: Graph Simplification & Optimization Passes
pipeline.description: Optimization pass chain (selected by preset or explicit list) runs at multiple stages (AFTER_AIL_GRAPH_CREATION, BEFORE_REGION_ID, etc.) to simplify AIL graph. Some passes (e.g., StaticVVarRewriter) rewrite virtual variables. Late passes can trigger RegionIdentifier re-runs if they modify graph topology.
pipeline.outputs: Simplified/optimized AIL graph, possibly new block structure

pipeline.name: Region Identification & Structuring
pipeline.description: decompiler._recover_regions() runs RegionIdentifier on AIL graph to identify loops, if-else diamonds, etc. Then RecursiveStructurer (SAILR, DREAM, or Phoenix) structures identified regions into SequenceNode tree. Structuring algorithm choice affects multi-expression-statement generation.

pipeline.name: Code Generation
pipeline.description: CStructuredCodeGenerator (or RustStructuredCodeGenerator) traverses SequenceNode tree and generates pseudocode text. Queries variable types from variable_manager, generates C declarations, handles casts, comments, and const formats. Options control formatting (cstyle_ifs, show_casts, braces_on_own_lines, etc.). Returns text + position/instruction mappings.
pipeline.inputs: seq_node, func, variable_kb, ail_graph, cfg, func_args, codegen options dict, notes/comments dicts
pipeline.outputs: codegen.text (C pseudocode), position mappings, instruction mappings

pipeline.name: LLM Refinement (Optional)
pipeline.description: If llm_refine option enabled, decompiler.llm_refine() calls LLM to suggest variable name/type improvements and function summaries. LLM can append notes to decompilation notes dict (persisted in cache). Does not auto-update KB; user must manually apply.
pipeline.outputs: Suggested names/types/summaries (user manually applies to KB)

feedback_loops.name: User Renames/Retypes -> Re-decompilation
feedback_loops.trigger: User calls kb.variables[func_addr].set_variable_type(var, ty, mark_manual=True) or directly modifies var.name and sets var.renamed=True
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Typehoon type inference step (if re-running full decompile) OR direct codegen re-render (via reflow_variable_types)
feedback_loops.mechanism: variables_with_manual_types set is used as ground_truth seed in next Typehoon run. If only codegen needs refresh, reflow_variable_types() re-runs Typehoon solver with updated ground_truth, then re-calls codegen without re-running variable recovery.

feedback_loops.name: Function Prototype Update -> Variable Recovery Re-seed
feedback_loops.trigger: kb.functions[addr].prototype is set (or kb.functions[addr]._prototype_source changes from GUESSED to USER). Next decompilation sees is_prototype_guessed=False.
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Variable recovery phase (clinic._recover_and_link_variables) OR only codegen if prototype is already in cache
feedback_loops.mechanism: Ground truth seeding injects function.prototype.args as type constraints on arg variables. If prototype changes, next full decompile will use new arg types. Cached codegen reflow also re-seeds with new prototype.

feedback_loops.name: Option Change -> Cache Invalidation & Re-decompile
feedback_loops.trigger: User changes decompilation option (e.g., structurer_cls, llm_refine, remove_dead_memdefs). Option.clears_cache flag determines if cache is invalidated.
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Earliest stage affected by option. If clears_cache=False (codegen options), only codegen re-renders. If clears_cache=True (clinic/optimization options), full decompile restarts.
feedback_loops.mechanism: decompiler._cache_parameters dict is computed from non-Display options at non-default values. _can_use_decompilation_cache() checks this. Mismatch triggers full re-decompile.

feedback_loops.name: Optimization Pass Graph Rewrites -> Region Identification Re-run
feedback_loops.trigger: Some optimization passes (stage DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION or later) modify AIL graph topology (add/remove edges, rewrite jumps) after initial RegionIdentifier has run.
feedback_loops.mechanism: delay_graph_updates flag controls whether initial region ID waits for late optimizations. If delays, graph updates trigger re-identification.

feedback_loops.name: Stack Variable Type Constraint -> Typehoon Re-run via reflow
feedback_loops.trigger: User inspects decompilation, realizes a stack variable should be a struct. Updates kb.variables[func_addr].set_variable_type(stack_var, StructType, mark_manual=True). Calls decompiler.reflow_variable_types(cache).
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Typehoon solver (no re-variable-recovery needed, constraints already cached)
feedback_loops.mechanism: reflow_variable_types re-runs Typehoon with updated ground_truth from variables_with_manual_types, then re-calls codegen. Stack variable max_sizes also fed to solver for array/struct size inference.

feedback_loops.name: Calling Convention Analysis -> Prototype Inference -> Re-codegen
feedback_loops.trigger: CompleteCallingConventionsAnalysis runs (separately or as part of pipeline) and infers/updates function.prototype for uncovered functions. Sets prototype_source to something other than GUESSED.
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: If prototype was None/guessed, next decompile will use inferred prototype (no explicit rewind, just first-class behavior). If user wants to force re-codegen with new prototype, calls decompiler.reflow_variable_types().
feedback_loops.mechanism: Prototype inferred from arg/return dataflow. On decompile, ground_truth seeded with prototype.args. Reflow re-seeds without re-variable-recovery.

feedback_loops.name: Type Constraint Solver Degradation -> Fallback
feedback_loops.trigger: Total type constraints exceed constraint_set_degradation_threshold (default 150). Solver may degrade or warn.
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: No rewind; solver degrades gracefully or logs warning. Next re-decompile with lower constraint count would produce cleaner types.
feedback_loops.mechanism: constraint_set_degradation_threshold parameter passed to Typehoon. If exceeded, may skip certain constraint classes. User can lower threshold or simplify code.

decision_points.name: Preset vs. Explicit Optimization Passes
decision_points.decision: If optimization_passes is provided, use it; else load preset (default or user-specified) and call preset.get_optimization_passes(arch, platform). Presets filter passes by architecture/platform support.
decision_points.alternatives: Different preset -> different optimization chain -> different graph simplification -> different variables recovered -> different code output. Explicit passes bypass presets entirely.
decision_points.current_override: preset parameter (str name or DecompilationPreset object), or optimization_passes kwarg

decision_points.name: Use Cache or Force Re-decompile
decision_points.decision: If use_cache=True and cache parameters match, load cached codegen/clinic; else do full decompile. Match check excludes Display-category options.
decision_points.alternatives: use_cache=False forces full re-decompile even if cache exists. Cached codegen avoids variable recovery; cached clinic avoids AIL conversion.
decision_points.current_override: use_cache boolean parameter, update_cache boolean to control cache persistence

decision_points.name: Structuring Algorithm Selection
decision_points.decision: Extract structurer_cls from recursive_structurer options; default is DEFAULT_STRUCTURER (SAILR). Algorithm affects fold_callexprs_into_conditions, force_loop_single_exit, complete_successors flags.
decision_points.alternatives: SAILR (simple), DREAM, Phoenix (schema-based) -> different loop handling, different multi-statement expression generation strategies.
decision_points.current_override: Structuring algorithm option with candidate_values ['SAILR', 'Phoenix', 'DREAM'], convert=structurer_class_from_name

decision_points.name: Variable Recovery Variable KB Source
decision_points.decision: If variable_kb provided, use it; else create tmp_kb from project KB. If func_addr already in variable_kb.variables, existing variables/types are preserved/merged.
decision_points.alternatives: Passing external variable_kb allows reusing variables across functions. No variable_kb means isolated per-function recovery.
decision_points.current_override: variable_kb parameter to Clinic, variable_kb parameter to Decompiler (forwarded to Clinic)

decision_points.name: Reset Variable Names on Re-decompile
decision_points.decision: reset_variable_names = (func_addr not in variable_kb.variables). If func not previously analyzed, names auto-generated. If in KB, existing names preserved (unless manually toggled).
decision_points.alternatives: reset_variable_names=True forces auto-naming, losing user renames. reset_variable_names=False preserves KB state.
decision_points.current_override: _reset_variable_names (computed internally, no direct user option yet)

decision_points.name: Ground-Truth Type Seeding Scope
decision_points.decision: Ground truth constructed from (1) var_manager.variables_with_manual_types (mark_manual=True), (2) function.prototype if not guessed. Only these types override solver.
decision_points.alternatives: Seeding all inferred types would remove solver freedom. Seeding none would ignore user edits. Current approach balances manual override + inference.
decision_points.current_override: No explicit option; controlled by user calling kb.variables[addr].set_variable_type(..., mark_manual=True)

decision_points.name: Multi-Statement Expression Generation Mode
decision_points.decision: use_multistmtexprs parameter (MultiStmtExprMode enum: NEVER, MAX_ONE_CALL, UNLIMITED). Rust flavor forces NEVER. Controls whether structurer folds multiple statements into single expression statements.
decision_points.alternatives: NEVER -> explicit sequential statements, more readable. MAX_ONE_CALL -> max one function call per statement (default). UNLIMITED -> aggressive folding for compact output.
decision_points.current_override: Multi-expression statements generation option with candidate_values, convert=MultiStmtExprMode

decision_points.name: Semantic Variable Naming Enable/Disable
decision_points.decision: semvar_naming option (bool, default True) controls if semantic naming orchestrator runs. If False, stage is skipped.
decision_points.alternatives: Disabled -> variables use heuristic names (ipXX). Enabled -> applied names like len, ptr, flag based on usage patterns.
decision_points.current_override: Name variables based on usage option (bool)

decision_points.name: Constrain Callee Prototypes from Call Sites
decision_points.where: Clinic (if option enabled, passed to analyses)
decision_points.decision: constrain_callee_prototypes option (bool, default True). If True, call site analysis constrains argument types of called functions, which may update their KB prototypes.
decision_points.alternatives: Disabled -> callee prototypes left as-is. Enabled -> interprocedural type flow improves callee signatures, affecting their decompilation.
decision_points.current_override: Constrain and improve callee function prototypes based on call site information option (bool)

decision_points.name: Dead Memdef Removal Aggressiveness
decision_points.where: Clinic graph simplification passes (controlled by clinic option)
decision_points.decision: remove_dead_memdefs option (bool, default False). Aggressive analysis to remove stack/memory variables deemed unused. Risk: false negatives.
decision_points.alternatives: Conservative (False) -> keep all recovered variables. Aggressive (True) -> cleaner output but may incorrectly remove used vars.

decision_points.name: Code Generation Flavor (C vs. Rust)
decision_points.decision: flavor parameter (default 'pseudocode', can be 'rust'). Selects codegen class (CStructuredCodeGenerator vs. RustStructuredCodeGenerator) and TypeHoon variant. Rust forces certain options off (simplify_ifelse, use_multistmtexprs=NEVER).
decision_points.alternatives: C -> standard decompilation. Rust -> Rust-specific output, different naming/semantics.
decision_points.current_override: flavor parameter to Decompiler, implicit in codegen_cls selection

intervention_surfaces.name: DecompilationOption catalog & defaults
intervention_surfaces.description: 45+ configurable options across 7 categories (Variables, Display, Structuring, Graph, Types, Data flows, LLM). Each DecompilationOption has name, description, value_type, cls (target class), param (method parameter), default_value, clears_cache flag, candidate_values, convert callback.
intervention_surfaces.affects: All stages; options routed to clinic, codegen, region_simplifier, recursive_structurer, region_identifier, decompiler classes

intervention_surfaces.name: Decompilation Presets (basic, fast, full, malware)
intervention_surfaces.description: Pre-curated optimization pass chains per preset, filtered by architecture and platform. Users can pass preset='fast' to Decompiler or define custom presets.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Optimization pass selection, which controls graph simplification order and scope

intervention_surfaces.name: Knowledge Base variable_manager (kb.variables)
intervention_surfaces.description: Users read/write kb.variables[func_addr] VariableManagerInternal. Key mutations: set_variable_type(var, ty, mark_manual=True), var.name = 'newname', var.renamed = True. These persist across re-decompilations if mark_manual=True.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Typehoon ground-truth seeding, variable unification, codegen (variable lookup), variable naming

intervention_surfaces.name: Function prototype (kb.functions[addr].prototype)
intervention_surfaces.description: Users set kb.functions[addr].prototype = SimTypeFunction(...) or leave it guessed. Prototype is seeded as ground truth for argument types. Setting prototype_source to USER prevents re-inference.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Variable recovery (arg variable type constraints), codegen (function signature)

intervention_surfaces.name: KB labels and debug info
intervention_surfaces.description: kb.labels dict maps address to label names. Used during variable naming to avoid collisions. Can be pre-populated from DWARF or user annotations.

intervention_surfaces.name: Variable recovery type_hints list
intervention_surfaces.description: User provides (VirtualVariable | MemoryLocation, type_string) tuples to Clinic (type_hints parameter). These constrain variable types early in recovery without modifying KB.

intervention_surfaces.name: External variable_kb parameter
intervention_surfaces.description: Pass pre-populated variable_kb (KnowledgeBase) to Decompiler/Clinic. Allows reusing/merging variable info across functions. If func_addr in variable_kb.variables, existing state is merged.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Variable recovery merging, type inference ground truth, codegen variable lookup

intervention_surfaces.name: Optimization pass whitelist/blacklist
intervention_surfaces.description: Decompiler accepts additional_opts and disable_opts to preset.get_optimization_passes(). Users can add custom optimization passes or skip specific ones.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Graph simplification, variable recovery constraints generation

intervention_surfaces.name: Decompilation notes (DecompilationNote dict)
intervention_surfaces.description: Decompiler.notes dict collects metadata about decompilation (warnings, inferred types, etc.). Passed to codegen and displayed in comments. Users can inspect/edit notes before re-codegen.

intervention_surfaces.name: Cache invalidation control
intervention_surfaces.description: use_cache (bool) and update_cache (bool) parameters control caching. use_cache=False forces re-decompile. update_cache=False prevents cache writes. Option.clears_cache flag per option controls granular invalidation.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Which stages re-run on subsequent decompilations

intervention_surfaces.name: reflow_variable_types() re-solver API
intervention_surfaces.description: Decompiler.reflow_variable_types(cache) allows external agents to trigger Typehoon re-run without full re-decompile. Picks up updated ground_truth from kb.variables[func_addr].variables_with_manual_types.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Type inference re-run, codegen re-render, function prototype re-inference

intervention_surfaces.name: Custom peephole optimizations
intervention_surfaces.description: Decompiler peephole_optimizations parameter accepts iterable of PeepholeOptimizationExprBase / PeepholeOptimizationStmtBase classes. Applied during structuring to simplify expressions/statements.

intervention_surfaces.name: Desired variables & must_struct
intervention_surfaces.description: Decompiler desired_variables (set of variable idents to focus on) and vars_must_struct (set of variable idents that must be struct types) parameters constrain variable recovery and type inference.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Variable recovery focus, type inference must_struct set, codegen declaration order

intervention_surfaces.name: Static vvars and buffers
intervention_surfaces.description: static_vvars (dict of VirtualVariable rewrite rules) and static_buffers allow user to inject known-good variable definitions into AIL graph before variable recovery.

intervention_surfaces.name: Expr/stmt comments and const formats
intervention_surfaces.description: expr_comments, stmt_comments (dicts mapping location to comment string), const_formats (dict controlling constant rendering) passed to codegen. Preserved in cache for reuse.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Codegen output comments and constant formatting

intervention_surfaces.name: Decompilation stage start/end/skip
intervention_surfaces.description: Clinic clinic_start_stage, clinic_end_stage, clinic_skip_stages parameters allow users to run partial pipelines (e.g., stop at RECOVER_VARIABLES, skip SEMANTIC_VARIABLE_NAMING) for debugging or custom workflows.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Which clinic stages execute, what output is available

insights: Variables and types are stored in the KB (kb.variables[func_addr]) and persist independently of decompilation. This is THE intervention surface: users modify SimVariable.name/renamed and call set_variable_type(..., mark_manual=True) to inject ground truth. A renamed variable survives re-decompilation if its ident matches.

The decompiler does NOT re-variable-recovery on codegen-only re-renders (use_cache=True with cached clinic); thus user-set types are only re-interpreted via Typehoon if called explicitly via reflow_variable_types(). This is intentional: codegen changes are decoupled from heavy analysis.

Type inference is a solver problem, not a pipeline: Typehoon is invoked once per decompile, but its constraints are cached (in DecompilationCache). User-injected ground_truth overrides solver results at specific TypeVariables. The solver is NOT iterative; no re-solving on user type edits—only if you explicitly call reflow_variable_types().

Semantic naming orchestrator is deterministic but post-hoc: it runs AFTER variable recovery and type inference are complete. It renames variables based on patterns (pointer naming, array indexing, etc.). User renames with var.renamed=True bypass semantic renaming automatically.

The most surprising coupling: function.prototype is used both as an input (ground truth for arg types) AND as an output (inferred from variable recovery if guessed). This creates a loop: complete_calling_conventions can infer prototypes, which seed the next decompile, which may refine them further.

Feedback loops are NOT automatic; they require explicit user action or a scheduled re-decompile: changing a variable type does NOT auto-reflow codegen unless the user calls reflow_variable_types(). This gives users control but requires awareness.

Optimization passes are ordered and can trigger cascading effects: some passes (during DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION stage) can modify AIL graph topology, which triggers RegionIdentifier re-run. This is the primary within-pipeline feedback loop (no external KB mutation needed).

The cache is the critical state boundary: DecompilationCache stores clinic, codegen, type_constraints, var_to_typevar mapping. If cache is valid, clinic is reused entirely, skipping variable recovery. If cache is invalid (option change with clears_cache=True), full re-decompile restarts from Clinic.

Options are NOT first-class objects in the decompilation pipeline; they are converted to parameter dicts (options_to_params()) and scattered to different analyses (clinic, codegen, structurer). A user changing an option doesn't 'interrupt' a stage; the entire Decompiler is re-instantiated with new options, triggering cache invalidation logic.

Variable unification is a static analysis (no solver): unify_variables() merges SSA phi-related variables into canonical unified_variables based on interference graph. This is independent of type inference; variables can unify without type constraints being resolved.
